boundary_notice: The biggest risk for hydrologists is not AI, but "only running models" - moving towards monitoring design, decision support and digital water conservancy, jobs will only become more scarce.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: Not suitable for people who are poor at math, afraid of the outdoors, or unable to sit still. Hydrological modeling is inseparable from mathematics and programming, and it will be very painful if you don't have a good foundation. Going out to the wild by rivers, wells, and during flood season is normal, and it cannot be done by squeamish people.
fit_decision_checklist.how: Common paths are: Hydrology and Water Resources/Hydraulic Engineering/Geographic Information Major → Getting started in data positions at hydrological stations or consulting companies → Mastering hydrological models and programming → Taking water conservancy-related professional qualifications → Turning to hydrological forecasting, water resources management or scientific research.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: It is suitable for people who have a good foundation in mathematics and science, can go into the wild, and have strong logic. Hydrology is a combination of mathematics and on-site work: the model must be calculated clearly, the field measurements must be accurate, and the results must be explained clearly; at the same time, during the flood control period, one must stay up late and stare at the data to withstand stress.

personality_fit_block.callout: For those who turn data into judgment and judgment into responsibility, no matter how fast AI is, you will always have a place at the flood prevention decision-making table.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Solid mathematics and physics: thorough understanding of model principles
Clear logic: the results are interpreted in an orderly manner
Able to go into the wild: Flow measurement and sampling are not too painful
Resist stress: you can survive the flood season by keeping an eye on the data
Responsibility: Dare to be responsible for forecast conclusions

personality_fit_block.callout: 把数据变成判断、把判断变成责任的人，无论 AI 多快，防汛决策桌前总有你的位置。
